description.en: An OpenAI-compatible inference platform with free sign-up credit (about ¥14 / 20M tokens) and many permanently free open models after real-name verification.
description.zh-Hans: OpenAI 兼容推理平台，新用户注册送约 ¥14（约 2,000 万 tokens）额度，完成实名认证后可使用大量永久免费开源模型。

detail.en: SiliconFlow (硅基流动) hosts 200+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Kimi, MiniMax, GLM etc.) behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint. New users receive a small credit grant (about ¥14, roughly 20M tokens of Qwen-class models) and can use permanently free model variants after real-name verification; free variants have fixed rate limits and cost 0. The endpoint can be connected to ChatSpeed.
detail.zh-Hans: 硅基流动（SiliconFlow）提供 200+ 开源模型（DeepSeek、Qwen、Llama、Kimi、MiniMax、GLM 等）的统一 OpenAI 兼容接口。新用户注册赠送约 ¥14 额度（约相当于 2,000 万 tokens 的 Qwen 类模型调用）；完成实名认证后可使用大量免费模型（名称不带 Pro/ 前缀的即免费版，调用费用为 0，限速固定）。该接口可接入 ChatSpeed 使用。

provider.name: SiliconFlow
provider.desc: An OpenAI-compatible hosted inference service with many permanently free open models.
